A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, figures and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite substantial changes in placement and layout.

before.justification: v2 reports original risk-control and efficiency experiments on eight in-context learning tasks and SQuAD v2.0, together with robustness studies and ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical studies and reports additional model results in Figures 5 and 7.

M1.justification: The confidence-based early exit, zero-shot fallback, context-relative loss and affine risk transformation remain unchanged. The half-depth exit restriction and all-tokens QA fallback rule were already documented in v2 Appendix J.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight ICL datasets and SQuAD v2.0, retaining the helpful and harmful context settings. The added model configurations do not introduce new datasets or task requirements.

E2.justification: The loss-clipping comparator and zero-shot/full-model reference predictions are retained. OLMo and Qwen are additional underlying evaluation models used with the existing procedures; the comparison-method membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: Figures 5 and 7 expand the ICL configurations beyond four LLaMA/LayerSkip models to Olmo-3-1125-32B, Olmo-3-1025-7B and Qwen3-8B. Figure 7 reports percentage of layers used instead of average exit layer. Separately, v2 Figure 16 becomes v3 Figure 17 with the SQuAD mixture changed from 90% unanswerable to 90% answerable in its caption; the unchanged curves indicate a reported-setting correction, without establishing a rerun.

E4.justification: The matched threshold-sensitivity, context-mixture, class-conditional, overthinking and component-ablation analyses retain their plotted evidence. Expanded model names in shared appendix legends do not correspond to additional curves or establish new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report one standard error over 100 experiments and bootstrap confidence intervals for threshold robustness. No change in repeated-run counts, seed reporting or uncertainty-estimation procedures is documented.

E6.justification: Figures 5 and 7 add results for three model configurations and revise curves for retained ICL models, including FinancialPhrasebank risk curves. These are newly reported or replaced results, without an explained basis for claiming same-setting performance improvements. The SQuAD curves, fallback frequencies of 3.0% versus 0.9%, and reported 53% ICL and up-to-81.8% QA layer reductions are retained.

T1.justification: The risk definitions, assumptions and affine-transformation proof remain mathematically equivalent. v3 Appendix B, formerly Appendix C, makes expectation algebra and the existing probability guarantee more explicit without adding a theorem or changing the reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same three contributions and central claims about controlling degradation relative to zero-shot while gaining efficiency. The additional model evidence does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Section 6 and Appendix G.3 newly qualify the halfway exit cutoff as task-dependent and explain how confident individual tokens could prevent fallback during long harmful generations. v3 also adds discussion of calibration/test mismatch, rare safety violations and complementary reasoning-time stopping, while retaining the existing subgroup-guarantee limitations.

D1.justification: v3 adds a reproduction-code repository link in the introduction and identifies the previously ambiguous TE-Feminist panels as LayerSkip and LLaMA in Figure 12. Existing prompt templates, GPT-5 reference-answer construction and four-A100 hardware information are retained and reorganized.

R1.justification: v3 adds Zou et al. (2024) on circuit breakers and Wang et al. (2026) on reasoning-model early exit to its future applicability discussion, and removes Radford et al. (2019). The main positioning relative to LTT, CALM and prior overthinking work remains unchanged; most other reference edits update metadata or consolidate duplicates.

P1.justification: v3 applies local language and notation cleanup, expands the conclusion, updates front matter and adds acknowledgments. It consolidates setup and prompt material in Appendix A and groups robustness sections under Appendix F, while preserving the main section sequence and most exposition.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with an explicit no-context input, and Figures 5 and 7 receive expanded legends and changed axes. Appendix figures are extensively resized, repacked and relocated, including moving the overthinking figure earlier and arranging Figure 25 in one row. Subplot labels and the SQuAD mixture caption are also corrected.

improvement.justification: v3 improves assessability through specific applicability limits, clearer subplot and mixture labeling, and a reproduction-code link. The additional model-family results broaden support beyond LLaMA. These gains are tempered by setup prose that still lists four ICL models and expanded appendix legends without corresponding new curves, leaving reporting inconsistencies that limit the overall improvement.
